source_excerpts.text:
ASTRA ULTRA — DETAILED PROGRAMME UPDATE
Status cutoff: 9 October 2026, 18:31 AEST / 08:31 UTC.
This is a progress report. The research programme remains active.
Post-cutoff development, 18:35 AEST: the commuting-game originator has now
frozen a full finite-tracial descriptor construction and the conditional-win
bound with B=4112, conditional on the stated correlation-sampler interface
and Lin finite-table density theorem. The independent sampler comparison
and fresh full composition review are pending. This is stronger progress
than the in-preparation status in section 8, but does not yet promote the
whole repetition theorem. A new annealed adaptive square-comparison proof
has also frozen; it awaits fresh review and still does not close the trace
or high-crossing gates.
The foundational 10/10 objective has NOT been achieved. We have several
substantial candidate theorems with complete internal proofs and independent
adversarial reconstructions, several shorter standalone results, and concrete
counterexamples that eliminated proposed extensions. No result has acquired
external expert validation, proof-assistant certification, or historical
priority clearance during this programme. That qualification applies even
where this report says an internal proof is complete.
The most mature broad result is the sharp regularity profile for finite
stationary quantum dynamics, together with its approximate-broadcasting
consequences. The most ambitious newer complete internal candidates concern
the square-lattice hard-Lipschitz field and singular sets of stationary
varifolds. The most promising active extension is unanchored repetition for
arbitrary commuting-operator games. Its full proof is not yet closed at this
cutoff.
1. Sources, scope and what verification means
Both research corpora were independently pinned:
  Astra: 39cdea532f19217f633f70315d92c314a6ce5e3e
  OpenAI Math: fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb
Both local source trees were rechecked Git-clean at this status cutoff.
The intake started from Astra's prescribed 00_START_HERE entrypoint and used
the claim/frontier/lemma/proof/obstruction records selectively. The OpenAI
manuscript corpus was inspected through complementary regional scouts and
targeted proof reconstructions. This is not an exhaustive audit of every
manuscript in the release.
The initial search covered quantum information and operator alg
